notes.title: Revival and Exploration Demo Ending on April 7, Planning to Release in 2025 Q2!
notes.notes:
Greetings my lords!

Revival and Exploration Demo is scheduled to close on [i][b]April 7 at 8 a.m.(PT) [/b][/i] Welcome everyone to participate in our demo, and leave your valuable suggestions before the official version is released! We are planning to launch the official version on Steam in[i][b] 2025 Q2[/b][/i], and [i][b]the save progress of the demo will not be inherited in the officially released version[/b][/i], sorry for the inconvenience.

In the officially released version, there are branches of new content available:
[olist]
[*] Unlock all areas: [Plain], [Desert], [Swamp], [Ruin], [Snowfield], [Volcano], and the new area [Dragon Palace].
[*] New classes and new residents
[*] Tribes, Chambers of Commerce, and more new gameplays!
[/olist]
The developer team is currently working hard for the official launch, looking forward to seeing you all soon!

CMS Gear

notes.title: Revival and Exploration Demo Release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/e93e2adda36a04b69ee05c7027b68908fee2ddcc.png[/img]

[u][b]Demo Content[/b][/u]

▶ 30+ Available Buildings

▶ Up to 12 Resident Classes

▶ [Plain] and [Desert] Areas

Thanks for playing! If you encounter any tech issues or have any questions about our game, feel free to contact us as follows！


1、Quick Feedback

Please click the “客服” button in the left corner of the game and input your feedback. Then, you will directly contact our service center.



2、Steam Community Discussion

Please leave your notes at the below link, we will regularly review this discussion board.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3382170/discussions/0/596266515199721169/]Revival& Exploration Feedback>>>[/url]



3、Offical Email

Please contact us via our official email.

zcstaff01@yijoys.com


4、You can also directly leave your questions or comments on this announcement.

*Attention: Revival and Exploration did not ask for your info such as ID, address, or finance related! Please take care of your private information.


Your comments are very important to improve and refine our game, thanks again!
